title: SNAP LATTICE
description: A field of bistable folded cells snaps between two stable relief states. Pressing one cell injects a local transition that can remain isolated or cascade through neighbours depending on barrier, coupling, bias and damping.

visual_finish.composition: a dark field of large folded facets forms coherent state domains instead of exposed solver pixels
visual_finish.material_model: graphite folded panels with pale relief faces and brief warm snap energy at active ridges
detail_scales: individual fold ridges and snap markers
